Answer: A
Reason: Comparing the initial CXR (Figure 1a) with the post-treatment CXR (Figure 1b), there is a marked reduction in the left-sided opacity and resolution of the mediastinal shift towards the left, indicating re-expansion of the collapsed lung. The follow-up CT (Figure 4a) confirms the absence of the previously seen large mediastinal mass and bronchial obstruction, consistent with tumor response to treatment.
